clues: Two accidents appeared in a single line
at the end of an appendix
items.reason: 二件の事故が付録の末尾に一行だけ載っていたと述べられています

sentences: The emergency fund bailed out several small businesses during the recession.
Each received enough cash to pay wages, and none of them closed that year.
clues: Each received enough cash to pay wages
none of them closed that year
items.reason: 各社が給与を払える資金を受け、その年は一社も倒れなかったと述べられています

sentences: The hungry hikers polished off the remaining sandwiches before sunset.

clues: Not a crumb was left in the box
two of them asked about dinner
items.reason: 箱にくずも残らず、二人はもう夕食の話をしていたと述べられています

sentences: A rival firm tried to muscle in on the profitable contract.

items.reason: 顧客へ直接接触し、仕事の半分を引き取ると申し出たと述べられています

sentences: Families stock up on bottled water before severe storms arrive.

items.reason: 二日前には棚が空になり、各家庭が六箱以上持ち帰ると述べられています
